budget_exhausted.other: Budget exhausted. Contact admin to top up.

insufficient_credits.other: Insufficient credits. Please subscribe or purchase a top-up package.

SESSION_FORBIDDEN.other: session not owned by this API key

content_filter.other: Your request was rejected by the content moderation system (reason: {{.Reason}}). Please rephrase your input and retry.

content_filter_hint.other: Check your input for sensitive or prohibited content and try again. The same request will be rejected by all providers of this model.

invalid_model.other: Model '{{.Model}}' is not supported by this gateway

model_deprecated.other: The requested model has been permanently removed (end-of-life) by the upstream provider.

unsupported_feature.other: The selected model does not support this request format or modality.

upstream_credential_invalid.other: Upstream credential API key invalid (provider rejected our key). This is a credential configuration issue, not a client key issue — contact the gateway administrator to refresh the upstream credential.

upstream_credential_revoked.other: Upstream credential API key revoked (provider reported the key is no longer active). This is a credential configuration issue — contact the gateway administrator to rotate the upstream credential.

upstream_quota_periodic.other: Upstream credential periodic quota exhausted (the provider reported a resettable usage window). This credential is temporarily unavailable and will recover after the quota window resets.

upstream_quota_permanent.other: Upstream credential quota permanently exhausted (provider returned 402 / quota_exceeded). This is a credential configuration issue — top up the upstream account or rotate the credential.

upstream_quota_balance.other: Upstream credential account balance exhausted (the provider reported insufficient balance). This is a credential configuration issue — top up the upstream account, then the credential recovers automatically.

upstream_quota_generic.other: Upstream credential quota exhausted (the provider reported a quota limit without saying whether it resets). This credential is temporarily out of rotation; contact the gateway administrator if it does not recover.

admin_proposal_not_pending.other: Proposal is not in pending status

admin_expires_at_invalid.other: expires_at must be in the future

admin_max_routes_exceeded.other: At most 3 model routes allowed per work type
